theme: An open day, with a couple of bookings past their dates
greeting: A genuinely open day, Dan — one hour of NACD at midday and the rest is yours. The loudest things in view are a pair of travel bookings that have quietly slipped past their dates.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: A p1 in your Household list, dated Sept 14 and still open. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the first rental in that market to sell out, so the refundable hold you flagged is the no-cost move.

needsAttention.title: December break destination
needsAttention.detail: The p2 travel item set a decide-by of Sept 30 and a book-by of Oct 15 — both now behind you. All four girls, Dec 13–Jan 2, over the thinnest holiday inventory of the year; your own note leans to the domestic shortlist.

needsAttention.title: Three term-life quotes for Mike
needsAttention.detail: A p2 in Household from Sept 25. Your half is the shopping — quotes, term length, coverage amount — and the target coverage and term are still the missing inputs.

flagged.title: ICGN Toronto — you moderate Plenary 7
flagged.detail: Final speaker info landed: Thurs Nov 5, 15:05–15:50 at U of Toronto, arrive 30 min early. A high-visibility stewardship-and-reporting panel worth prepping.

flagged.title: Meta migrated your login
flagged.detail: Meta moved your sign-in to a Meta Account — informational; nothing to do unless it looks unfamiliar.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promos — Responsible Investor, home-listing alerts, Airbnb, Harry & David, sailing and napkin ads.

resolved.title: Free conference ticket, sorted with Jen
resolved.detail: You replied to Jen Sisson about the complimentary ICGN ticket this morning; she's confirming it with Elle, so the ball is in her court.

recipe.why: An autumn dish that leans on what the season brings in — roots, squash, and slow heat.

acts.line: Nothing was booked before noon — a rare clear morning.
One hour anchored the day: the NACD program from 1 to 2.
The evening is unclaimed, with the girls home in St. Pete.
